description_ru: Fluviatile deposits: silt, sand and gravel (3a terraces, 3b modern flood plains, 3c alluvial fans, 3d silt and clay of fluvial or glaciolacustrine origin with thermokarst depressions)
Glacio-fluvial deposits: sand, gravel, minor silt (2a terrace and pitted terrace, kame terrace and outwash delta; 2b hummocky or ridged deposits; 2c esker complex deposits)
Glacial deposits: silt, minor sand and gravel (1a terminal and recessional moraine; 1b ground moraine; 1c dead-ice deposits with hummocky or knob-and-kettle form)
